simple.meaning: יוֹמָם (yôwmâm) is a Hebrew object word meaning “daily.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 13:21. The surrounding context includes Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יוֹמָם (H3119) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: יוֹמָם (yôwmâm) / H3119 is traced through Exodus 13:21, Exodus 13:22, Exodus 40:38, Leviticus 8:35 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:
Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:
the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”
Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahweh had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.
They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before Yahweh, be near to Yahweh our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;
These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service; for they were employed in their work day and night.

that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name; to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

Let your ear now be attentive, and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.
Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”
Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

definitions.full: H3119. yomam יוֺמָם 51 substantive and adverb daytime, by day (compare Aramaic יְמָמָא day (as opposed to night ); יֵמָם ᵑ7 by day ; perhaps Phoenician ימם (in dates, before number), CIS I. i. 10. 1 (see note); so Nö ZDMG 1886, 721 : on םָ֯ see below חִנָּם ) — 1. substantive daytime (rare) Jer 15:9 יומם בעוד while it is yet daytime , 33:20 b ולילה יומם הֱיוֺת לְבִלְתִּי daytime and night, 33:25 י ׳בְּרִיתִי ולילה (? read יוֺם as 33:20 a); Ezek 30:16 יוֺמָם צָרֵי foes of daytime , i.e. coming by day (compare Jer 15:8 ; but text apparently defective, see ᵐ5 Sm); once (late) בְּיוֺמָם (compare בְּיֵמָם ᵑ7 1Sam 25:16 ; Job 5:14 ), Neh 9:19 (varied from Exod 13:21 ; Deut 1:33 יומם ). — Num 9:21 the sense required is (during) a day and a night; read probably יוֺם 2. adverb in the daytime, by day , Num 10:34 ; Job 24:16 (but see חִתֵּם ), Isa 4:6 ; Ezek 12:3-4 , 7 ; mostly with לַיְלָה , and then often in poetry = continually: so וָלַיְלָה יוֺמָם Exod 13:21 ; Josh 1:8 ; 1Kin 8:59 ; Psa 1:2 ; 32:4 +, וְיוֺמָם לַיְלָה Deut 28:66 ; Isa 34:10 ; Jer 14:17 , in parallel clauses (especially in poetry) 2Sam 21:10 ; Isa 21:8 ; Jer 31:35 ; Psa 22:3 ; 42:9 ; 91:5 ; 121:6 +. 13:3 by day yields a lame sense: either add וָלַיְלָה ( ᵐ5 Del Gr Ch), or read יֹם יֹם יוֺם) (יוֺם Lag Nov.Psalt.Gr.Ed.Spec.13 Now. I. יון (√ of following; meaning unknown).
